spotify: No access_token for public APIs (show_song/album/artist, search_songs/albums/artists/users, show_song_reviews, show_genres): it raises 'Unexpected parameter'. Library, liked, queue, player, playlist-edit APIs need your token. A person named in a song/artist question is an ARTIST: use search_artists, not search_users.
spotify.show_song: Public: no access_token. Returns play_count, rating, release_date, genre (string), duration, artists[{id,name,genre,follower_count}]. Library/liked/queue/playlist items do NOT carry play_count, release_date or genre: call show_song(song_id) for each id.
spotify.show_album: Public: no access_token. Returns release_date, genre, rating and songs[{id,title,artists}] (song key is `id`, there is no song_ids here). Album-library list items DO have song_ids.
spotify.show_artist: Public: no access_token. Fields: name, genre, follower_count (NOT `followers`), following status is separate (show_artist_following).
spotify.search_artists: Public: no access_token. Use typed filters genre=, min_follower_count=, max_follower_count= (not free-text query). Items have artist_id, name, genre, follower_count. Paginate with page_limit=20 until an empty page.
spotify.show_song_library: Items only have song_id, title, album_id, artists, added_at (no play_count/release_date/genre). Paginate: page_limit=20, loop page_index until []. 'Liked' is a different list: show_liked_songs.
spotify.show_album_library: Items have album_id, song_ids, release_date, genre, rating. Songs of 'my album library' = all song_ids of these albums. Paginate: page_limit=20 until an empty page.
spotify.show_playlist_library: Items have playlist_id, title, is_public, song_ids. Paginate: page_limit=20 until an empty page. To read someone's or a private playlist via show_playlist pass access_token.
spotify.show_playlist: Pass access_token for private/own playlists (else 422 'not public'). Songs are in `songs`[{id,title,artists}], not song_ids.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Songs you liked (liked_at). Not the same as the song library. Paginate: page_limit=20 until an empty page. like_song/unlike_song/follow_artist/download_song give 422 if the state already holds: check first, skip those.
spotify.review_song: 409 if you already reviewed this song. Then find your review_id via show_song_reviews(song_id=, user_email=<your email>) and call update_song_review(review_id, rating=). Same pattern for albums and playlists.
spotify.play_music: Pass at most ONE of song_id, album_id, playlist_id, queue_position. Album/playlist is added to the queue and its first song starts. show_current_song tells what is playing; show_song_queue lists the queue in order.
spotify.show_song_queue: Ordered queue (position = index+1). 'Played so far' = entries before the current song plus the current one (match show_current_song song_id); print the queue and the current song before acting.
venmo: Login username = email. 'Now' is NOT datetime.now(): use phone get_current_date_and_time. search_users is FUZZY: its results never prove an account exists; compare emails exactly. To send money use create_transaction, to ask for money create_payment_request.
venmo.create_transaction: Sends REAL money (receiver_email, amount, description, private, payment_card_id). Response message is 'Sent money.'. On 422 'balance does not have' retry with payment_card_id of each non-expired card from show_payment_cards until one works. Do not call add_to_venmo_balance (extra BankTransfer = collateral).
venmo.add_to_venmo_balance: Creates an extra BankTransfer record, which counts as unwanted change. Avoid unless the task explicitly asks to add money to the balance; to pay from a card use create_transaction(payment_card_id=).
venmo.create_payment_request: Asks for money; nothing is paid. Params: user_email, amount, description, private. Create one request per person, with that person's own amount.
venmo.show_transactions: direction='sent' or 'received' only; min_created_at/max_created_at as 'YYYY-MM-DD'; user_email filters the counterparty. Items: transaction_id, amount, description, sender{email}, receiver{email}, like_count. Paginate page_limit=20.
venmo.show_social_feed: Friends' transactions with created_at, sender/receiver emails, like_count. Paginate page_limit=20 until []. Filter by date (phone 'today') and by contact emails in code, then like_transaction one by one.
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: status='pending'|'approved'|'denied'. Items: payment_request_id, amount, created_at, approved_at, denied_at, receiver{email}. Filter receiver email against the right phone contacts and the age against the phone date before remind_payment_request.
venmo.show_received_payment_requests: status='pending'|'approved'|'denied'. Items have sender{email}. Act only on requests whose sender email belongs to the contacts the task names; leave all others untouched.
phone: Login username = your PHONE NUMBER (not email). Today's date: get_current_date_and_time() -> {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': ...} (no token); never use datetime.now(). Friends, family, coworkers = phone contacts (their `relationships` list).
phone.search_contacts: No list-all API: loop with empty query, page_limit=20. `relationships` is a LIST (e.g. ['manager','coworker']); match case-insensitively; parents = mother/father/parent, siblings = brother/sister/sibling. Exact phone/email match in code. Fields: first_name,last_name,email,phone_number.
phone.search_text_messages: query matches the message TEXT, not the sender: filter by sender/recipient with phone_number=<digits>. Paginate (page_limit=20). Print one item to see its id and field names. Same for search_voice_messages.
phone.update_alarm: Modify the EXISTING alarm (alarm_id, time 'HH:MM', enabled). Print all alarms first; find by label ignoring case, hyphens and spaces. Do not create_alarm for 'move/change/disable'.
file_system: Login username = email, with the file_system password. Paths are absolute '/...' or '~/...'. Use this app, never os/open. Dates: phone 'today', not datetime.now(). Print file content before parsing it.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path (full new path including file name). Create the target folder first: create_directory(directory_path, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True). Moving/renaming keeps one file; do not copy.
file_system.show_directory: Params directory_path, entry_type ('files'|'directories'), recursive, substring. Returns full path strings. Use entry_type='files' to avoid folders. Print the result before moving, deleting or renaming anything.
file_system.create_file: Params file_path, content, overwrite. Rows/CSV: write exactly the requested separator and header, one line per record, no stray spaces; verify with show_file.
simple_note: Login username = email, with the simple_note password. search_notes returns NO content and lists pinned notes first: call show_note(note_id) for the content and read all of it before deciding.
supervisor.complete_task: answer ONLY when the task asks a question; it must be a plain number or string (no list/dict). Action tasks (like, follow, send, move, delete, play...): call complete_task() with NO answer. status='fail' only as a last resort. No `message` param.
supervisor.show_payment_cards: Supervisor cards (not Venmo's). Venmo's own cards come from venmo.show_payment_cards; use those ids for payment_card_id.
